The '''Demon of Darkness''' was a [[Zamorak]]ian [[demon]] who had to be defeated in order to obtain a [[Demon's heart (darkness)|demon's heart]] for [[Kolodion]]'s spell during [[Mage Arena II]] [[Miniquests|miniquest]]. In order to summon it, players had to use an [[enchanted symbol]] to locate it, similar to using an [[enchanted key]] or [[strange device]].

It was replaced by [[Porazdir]] on [[Update:PvM QoL updates & Wilderness Rejuvenation improvements|an update]] on February 8th [[2018]].

It was recommended to keep [[Protect from Magic]] active during the entire fight. Even though it was able to hit through it, the damage players take would be halved. If players were assigned a [[black demon]] for their [[Slayer task]], wearing a [[slayer helmet (i)]] was recommended, as the player's attacks would be more accurate.

The demon could only be harmed by the [[Flames of Zamorak]] spell or the [[twisted bow]]. As such, a [[Zamorak staff]], [[Staff of the Dead|staff of the dead]] or its [[Toxic Staff of the Dead|toxic counterpart]] was required to defeat it if using magic.

If not slain quick enough, the demon would despawn and the player would have to track it again and restart the fight.

If the player slew the demon as part of a black demon Slayer assignment given by [[Krystilia]], it would not have a chance of dropping a [[Slayer's enchantment]] or [[mysterious emblem]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/935843765943721984|date=29 November 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99205|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=[if assigned black demons by Krystilia, do the new Mage Arena II quest demons have a chance of dropping slayer's enchantment/mysterious emblem?] I don't think so.}}
